notes.title: Try Me, I Insist
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=i9-tDD_cljM;full][/previewyoutube]
The demo for Fire Me, I Insist is here—time to sharpen your office politics skills!

In this darkly comedic workplace sabotage sim, your goal isn’t to climb the corporate ladder—it’s to kick everyone else off it. Outsmart your coworkers, set them up for failure, and watch as they're booted out the company.

What to Expect in the Demo:
✔ A preview of the absurd office politics and questionable character dialogue
✔ An insight into the surprising evidence you can find against your colleagues 
✔ A look at the game’s pixel-art style and dark humour
✔ A tour around the chaotic offices of Bog-Standard Solutions

What office infidelities will you find? Try the demo now and start thinning the herd.
